# Hot Beam Productions

> Denver-based live event production company delivering lighting, lasers, LED video, and special effects for touring artists, festivals, venues, campus shows, and brand events. One accountable crew plans, builds, and runs the show from prep through strike.

Hot Beam Productions provides tour-grade technical production for live events where reliability is non-negotiable. The team specializes in FDA variance-compliant laser operation, lighting design and show operation, LED video and media systems, and atmospheric/impact special effects. Based in Denver, Colorado, serving the Front Range and nationwide.

- Service area: Denver, Colorado — Front Range and nationwide (12+ states served)
- Contact: info@hotbeamproductions.com / (720) 955-8929
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hotbeamproductions/

## Services

- [Lighting](https://www.hotbeamproductions.com/#capabilities): Lighting systems designed for live audiences and cameras — previsualization, cue programming, touring and one-off rigs, timecode and busked operation.
- [Lasers](https://www.hotbeamproductions.com/#capabilities): Variance-compliant laser shows with tight cue sync and operator-first safety — FDA-compliant operation, touring and venue laser packages, timecode/DMX/Art-Net integration.
- [LED Video](https://www.hotbeamproductions.com/#capabilities): LED walls, IMAG, and playback systems with stable routing and switching, processing, and venue-specific mapping.
- [SFX](https://www.hotbeamproductions.com/#capabilities): Atmospherics and impact effects timed to musical moments — CO2, haze, and confetti systems with cue-synced timing and site-specific safety planning.

## Who They Serve

- Touring artists needing rider-aware production packages that travel cleanly across venues.
- Festivals and venues running high-stakes shows that cannot miss.
- Corporate and brand events requiring polished, on-brand technical execution.
- Collegiate and campus concert events.

## How Booking Works

1. Share the show basics — date, venue, and priorities (about two minutes).
2. Review a right-sized scope with clear crew, gear, and timeline options.
3. Execute with one accountable lead team through load-in, show call, and strike.
